Experience

    •  Post-doctoral research fellow at Kansai Institute for Photon Science (QST) in
     Japan from January 2021 to December 2023.
    •  National Post-doctoral Fellow (NPDF) at Department of Physics, IIT Bombay from
       April 2024 to April 2026.
    •  Visiting Scientist at MPI-PKS Dresden from April 2026 to June 2026.

Research summary

  Ph.D:
   Study of laser-cluster interaction using molecular dynamics modeling, specifically the
    effect of intense femtosecond pulses on noble gas clusters using classical molecular
    dynamics.
  Post-Doctoral work:
   Study of the onset and nature of damage in silicon films using Three-Temperature
   Model and the effect of different interaction parameters on the damage threshold as
   a part of the ultrafast electronic dynamics project at Kansai Institute for Photon
   Science (QST) in Kyoto, Japan.
  ANRF-NPDF Project:
    Simulating laser-driven electron dynamics by solving the equations of motion within
    the density matrix formalism, to study non-linear response from 2D materials and
    topological quantum materials at the Attosecond Physics Lab, IIT Bombay.

Collaborations

   •  Dynamics and Interactions in the Condensed Phase (DICO), Université Paris-
      Saclay, CEA, LIDYL, Paris, France.
   •  Laser Advanced  Materials  Processing (LAMP)  Laboratory, Department  of
      Mechanical Engineering, IIT Bombay.

Publications
